text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Once we get over there, it'll start right 
away. The final Tiara race... the Shuka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. There's somewhere I want to 
go first once we arrive at the venue."
choice_data_list: Where do you want to go?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Um, you see...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa-ah?! Scarlet?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, talk about dramatic. If you're a 
delinquent, shouldn't you be saying 
something like, "What're you here for?!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So loud... Geez, what is it? The race is 
about to start, you know.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I know, so just give me one minute.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I take back what I said before. About you 
being "lame."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Still, wouldn't you say you're the one 
being 'uncool' right now?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You gave up on the Tiara route, didn't 
you? Did you think you couldn't take first 
place because I'm here?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...You know...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She's seriously in the way, makes no 
sense, and does nothing but call me 
"cool." She's just plain annoying.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Still, it's not uncool.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's why I won't give up first place to 
you. I refuse to let you have it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to take 1st place in this Shuka 
Sho. I'll prove that I'm the stronger 
one."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: To everyone, and to myself.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Steel your resolve. The resolve to lose, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hah...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Talk all you want. I'm gonna twist you up 
real easy—with my running!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph, act cocky while you still can.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go. To our stage.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win... against her!!
